result.instructions: Tools for Tokeet, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my rentals are free next weekend?"; "Show my open tasks, like cleanings and check-ins, and who they are assigned to."; "Show my recorded expenses with their amounts and rental names.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tokeet data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tokeet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tokeet_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tokeet_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. tokeet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tokeet_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Tokeet user the API key belongs to (name, email, role). Login data is never returned. GET /user/me.

tools.name: tokeet_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the team members (users) of the Tokeet account. GET /user.

skip.description: Rows to skip, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: tokeet_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One team member by id. GET /user/{user_pkey}.

user_id.description: User id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_list_rentals
tools.title: List rentals
tools.description: List the rental properties in the account, sorted by name. GET /rental.

skip.description: Rows to skip, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: tokeet_get_rental
tools.title: Get rental
tools.description: One rental property by id (its pkey from tokeet_list_rentals). GET /rental/{rental_pkey}.

rental_id.description: Rental id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_list_rentals_by_owner
tools.title: List rentals by owner
tools.description: List the rentals assigned to one owner. GET /rental/owner/{owner_pkey} (Tokeet documents no paging for it: all of the owner's rentals come back).

owner_id.description: Owner id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_get_rental_availability
tools.title: Get rental availability
tools.description: The open and blocked dates of one rental over the next two years. GET /rental/{rental_pkey}/availability.

rental_id.description: Rental id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_list_rates
tools.title: List rental rates
tools.description: All standard, dynamic and promotional rates of one rental. Read-only: rates cannot be changed with this server. GET /rate/{rental_pkey}.

rental_id.description: Rental id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

skip.description: Rows to skip, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: tokeet_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List guests (personal data: name, emails, phones, address, notes, interactions), one page at a time. Filter by partial name, booking source/channel, and whether they have bookings. GET /guest.

name.description: Partial guest name (matched by regex on the name).

source.description: Only guests from this channel/source, e.g. airbnb.

skip.description: Rows to skip, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: tokeet_get_guest
tools.title: Get guest
tools.description: One guest by id: contact details, notes, interactions and preferences. GET /guest/{pkey}.

guest_id.description: Guest id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_get_guest_by_email
tools.title: Get guest by email
tools.description: The guest whose primary email is exactly this address. GET /guest/email/{email}.

tools.name: tokeet_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List the tasks (to-dos, e.g. cleanings and check-ins) in the account, sorted by task name. GET /task.

skip.description: Rows to skip, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: tokeet_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id. GET /task/{task_pkey}.

task_id.description: Task id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List the expenses recorded in the account (date, rental, category, amount, paid/unpaid status), by creation date. Read-only. GET /expense.

skip.description: Rows to skip, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: tokeet_get_expense
tools.title: Get expense
tools.description: One expense by id. GET /expense/{expense_pkey}.

expense_id.description: Expense id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_list_templates
tools.title: List message templates
tools.description: List the message/email templates in the account, optionally of one type. GET /template.

skip.description: Rows to skip, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: tokeet_get_template
tools.title: Get message template
tools.description: One message template by id. GET /template/{template_pkey}.

template_id.description: Template id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_list_triggers
tools.title: List automation triggers
tools.description: List the automation triggers (event, rental, template, delay) in the account. Read-only: triggers cannot be changed with this server. GET /trigger.

skip.description: Rows to skip, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: tokeet_create_guest
tools.title: Create guest
tools.description: WRITE: create a guest record (name and email required, the rest optional). Nothing is sent to the guest. Tokeet cannot recover deleted data and this server cannot delete guests. POST /guest.

kids.description: Names of the guest's children, as one string.

tools.name: tokeet_update_guest
tools.title: Update guest
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a guest (name, address, birthday, spouse, kids, drink, hobby, sport). Only the fields you pass are sent, and each one OVERWRITES the stored value (an address object replaces the whole address). Emails and phones have their own endpoints and are not changed here. PUT /guest/{guest_pkey}.

guest_id.description: Guest id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

kids.description: Names of the guest's children, as one string.

tools.name: tokeet_add_guest_note
tools.title: Add guest note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a guest record (not visible to or sent to the guest). POST /guest/{guest_pkey}/note.

guest_id.description: Guest id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

tools.name: tokeet_record_guest_interaction
tools.title: Record guest interaction
tools.description: WRITE: log an interaction you had with a guest (phone call, meeting or comment) in the guest's history. Nothing is sent to the guest. `date` is an epoch timestamp: use the same unit as the dates you see on existing interactions from tokeet_get_guest. POST /guest/{guest_pkey}/interaction.

guest_id.description: Guest id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

date.description: Epoch timestamp of the interaction (same unit as Tokeet's other dates).

tools.name: tokeet_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (to-do) in the account, optionally linked to an inquiry and assigned to a user. `due` is an epoch timestamp: use the same unit as the `due` of existing tasks from tokeet_list_tasks. No message is sent to anyone by this call. POST /task.

list.description: Name of the task list to add it to.

due.description: Epoch timestamp when the task is due (same unit as existing tasks).

inquiry_id.description: Inquiry (booking) id the task relates to.

user_id.description: User id the task is assigned to (see tokeet_list_users).

tools.name: tokeet_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task: rename, move to another list, reschedule, edit notes, reassign, or mark it completed (status 2) or active (1). Only the fields you pass are sent and each OVERWRITES the stored value. PUT /task/{task_pkey}.

task_id.description: Task id (the id / pkey Tokeet returns for it).

due.description: Epoch timestamp when due (same unit as existing tasks).

user_id.description: User id to assign the task to.
